## About

These are the cases of [`b-panzoom-lightbox`](b-panzoom-lightbox.html),
[`c-panzoom-auto`](c-panzoom-auto.html), and
[`d-panzoom-selective`](d-panzoom-selective.html), opened by lightbox
without panzoom. Compare each case with the same number there. Every block
image opens in lightbox, with these settings:

```yaml
lightbox:
  match: auto
  effect: fade
  desc-position: right
  loop: true
  css-class: my-lb
```

## 5. R subfigures (fig-subcap, layout-ncol) {#c5 expect-open="glightbox"}

```{r}
#| label: fig-r-sub
#| fig-cap: "Two R subfigures."
#| fig-subcap: ["Pressure", "Cars"]
#| layout-ncol: 2

plot(pressure)
plot(cars)
```

## 6. R chunks with lightbox cell options (group + description) {#c6 expect-open="glightbox"}

This chunk sets a lightbox group and description.

```{r}
#| fig-cap: Simple demo R plot
#| lightbox:
#|   group: r-graph
#|   description: This is 1 to 10 plot

plot(1:10, rnorm(10))
```

So does this one, in the same group.

```{r}
#| fig-cap: Plot about cars data
#| lightbox:
#|   group: r-graph
#|   description: We see our cars data above

plot(cars)
```

## 7. Multi-plot cell, list-valued options {#c7 expect-open="glightbox"}

```{r}
#| fig-cap:
#|   - Caption for first plot
#|   - Caption for second plot
#| lightbox:
#|   group: cars
#|   description:
#|     - Description for first graph
#|     - Description for second graph

plot(mtcars)
plot(cars)
```

## 8. lightbox: false on a chunk {#c8 expect-open="nothing"}

```{r}
#| fig-cap: mtcars, lightbox false
#| lightbox: false

plot(mtcars)
```
